items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Pete; the mention of Pete is made by the Interviewer ('I can remember Pete telling...'). The Interviewee's response ('Well if you work with dancers...') addresses the context of the jokes generally, not a personal relationship with Pete.

ctx.x: Hmm. And I've never known why either. It's something I never thought about.

Yeah, I never thought about it either. That was one of his nicknames. He was a, he was just a, I don't know, he was, I don't mean this with any disrespect, but Tony Almerico was what would have been termed, I guess, a square. You know, he was very innocent, very trusting. He didn't, he smoked that cigar. I don't think he probably, in his entire life, never consumed a fifth of alcohol. He wasn't a drinker. And he was a hard worker, and a just getting out and flat hustling kind of guy. And he never expected anybody…
Well if you work with dancers that would be very important, to keep the stage clean.
